description: decoder_base.v (build A) vs decoder_rewrite.v (build B): an equivalent combinational rewrite -- De Morgan'd decode, MUX-based enable gating, OR2 tree instead of OR4. Every register keeps its name.
notes: The mapping is the identity, written out rather than inferred, so the run records exactly which registers it claimed to cover.
Because it is the identity, the z3_utils.compare_nets cross-check applies and is expected to agree at every point.
